net.raphimc.viabedrock.api.model.NativeItemStackData
public record NativeItemStackData(int itemId, short auxiliaryValue, int blockRuntimeId, long blockingTicks, List<String> canPlace, List<String> canBreak, com.viaversion.nbt.tag.CompoundTag userData) extends Record
Immutable decoded Bedrock stack data before Java conversion. Count stays in the Java stack.

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
